node.title: Re: Qualified package variable access
node.author: jerryhone
node.doctext: Thanks Brother Rolf. 'our' is the fix. I've been using Perl on and off for 20 odd years and that's the first time I've used 'our' as far as I recall. My very well thumbed O'Reilly camel book (2nd edition 1996!) doesn't actually mention it!
